department: Department of Chemistry and Chemical Biology

deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (catalog); the department starts review on the first Monday in December and late applicants may be at a disadvantage.
deadline.quote: Fall, December 1. | Application Review begins Dec. 1.

also.quote: Review of applications to the Ph.D. program will begin on the first Monday in December each year for admission into the program beginning in the following August.

gre_general.value: The 2026-27 catalog says GRE scores are required (test not named); confirm with chemgrad@cornell.edu.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Students do three lab rotations in the first semester before joining a research group.
supervisor.quote: Each incoming student will complete three three-week rotations before officially joining a laboratory.

funding.value: At least five years of full support (12-month stipend, tuition, health insurance) with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Each Ph.D. student is therefore guaranteed at least five years of full financial support as long as he or she makes satisfactory progress toward the Ph.D. degree.

entry_route.value: A US-equivalent bachelor's in chemistry (with analytical, inorganic, organic and physical chemistry) is expected.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have the equivalent of a U.S. bachelor's degree in chemistry

notes: Interviews (Zoom or in person) may be part of the process.
